name: nGZSceneGraph::cGeometryBuilderBehaviorTraits::RegistryFor (the geometry builders' event registry)
notes: Lane SM (H1b part 9). Hooked (cdecl, 32-byte CRC site). A function-local static map built on first use and returned from every call, `attribute` stored under `id` first when id is not 0: a copy of the base registry (0x1485f0) plus the event 0xbbb112f6 (record 0x106ab4c). SG_GeometryBuilder_Registry: 600 seeds of 1-6 calls (ids from a fixed pool plus random, random records), against the original started from the state its first-use build leaves (the parents' maps and this map placed at their statics with the guards and once bytes marked done, the holder's registrations then run through the real registry; ours starts from nothing); after every call the returned map's identity and every record (key, id, name, three words, last) of this map, its parent and the base registry are compared. Mutants: record swapped, id store skipped, parent copy skipped, each killed.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cGeometryBuilderBehaviorTraits registry holder (once-byte step)
notes: Lane SM. The registry's holder (run on every call of 0xa453a0, a once byte skipping it after the first): makes a small object kept in a static (read by nothing) and runs the base events (0x1464f0) and stores 0xbbb112f6 through 0xa453a0.
